verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's own marketing docs describe JumpCloud Go as a hardware-protected, phishing-resistant passwordless login for web resources, and list biometric, hardware-key and authenticator-app (JumpCloud Protect) methods. However, the passwordless flow is scoped to managed devices, and the biometric and hardware-key options are presented as MFA factors rather than password replacements. missing for 10: explicit passkey/FIDO2 passwordless support, passwordless use on unmanaged devices or for non-web resources, in-depth setup documentation beyond marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can sign in without a password — passwordless flows via passkeys, authenticator, or platform biometrics documented and supported

citations.quote: Pair with JumpCloud Go™ for a hardware-protected and phishing-resistant MFA passwordless login method for users to access web resources from managed devices.

Use JumpCloud Protect — our free authenticator app — or integrate your own provider, and choose from push-based, time-based one time passwords (TOTP), JumpCloud Go, hardware keys, biometric, certificates, or other methods
